title: File
description: Represents a file which has been uploaded, imported or converted.

id.description: The unique identifier assigned to the file

key.description: The API key which was used to create the file

name.description: The name that was specified for the file (must not be more than 256 chars)

size.description: The size of the file in bytes, derived from the content of the file

format.description: The identifier of the format of the file

created_at.description: The time at which the file was created on Zamzar servers (UTC in ISO_8601)
